model.summary: Model favors NE by 11.2 points (83% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (NE +4.0), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (NE +2.8), Quarterback rating (NE +2.7). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 45.7 total points (NE 28, NYJ 17). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.8), Divisional game (lowers total 0.7), Natural grass field (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
